notes.title: Retirement Of Game
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

We would like to announce that we will be retiring this game off of the Steam store page due to some issues with the game and the game not being an accurate representation of the company.

[b]What this means if you own the game: [/b] For people that own the game you won't notice anything, you will still be able to play it.

[b]What this means for new players: [/b] As the store page won't be around anymore no new players will be able to buy the game.

We thank you all for playing Escape and we are sorry about not being able to fix some issues with the game. Keep an eye out on our Steam page though as we do have new things coming soon!

notes.title: Update V0.12
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

We have done another update, this one mainly focuses on lighting and achievements. Here are the patch notes:

- Three new achievements added (Encountering Main enemy, white ghost and dying for the first time)
- We have improved the lighting by making the scene a little darker
- We have fixed the lens flares being so intense all the time
- Updated the main killers mask to have blood
- Some menu improvements and changes (Font and positioning)
- Made it so the main enemy doesn't appear to the player so quickly
- And a few optmizations

Regards: Ragdoll Inc

notes.title: New Update
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

This update was mainly focused on optmization but we have made some more changes. Here's the change log:

- Main enemy now carries an axe
- Main enemy texture change to black suit as the "meat" one didn't look right
- Major optmizations

notes.title: Update V0.11 (OverHaul)
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

I am excited to finally have this update out. Here are the change notes:

- 5 new achievements (Maybe More down the track)
- All new terrain shader to make the ground look real
- procedurally generated sky with moving clouds
- re-worked moon shafts and moon
- better post processing effects (Adding better bloom, metalic colours and dirt)
- Adding an extra audio track for ambient sound
- much better lighting
- changed the flashlight light colour as it was too yellow
- changed the shader that the whole game is rendered in
- most textures are now PBR
- and minor bug fixes

We hope you will all enjoy this update, I will be updating the screenshots soon.

Regards: Ragdoll Inc

notes.title: Massive Overhaul, coming tomorrow!
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

Tomorrow we will be releasing update 0.11 and we wanted to let you know a little about it before tomorrow.

- We will be adding long awaited achievements(Only a few for now). 
- A complete graphical overhaul (Dynamic sky, New shaders, effects and PBR textures).

We will give you the full extensive list of additions and changes tomorrow!

(Sorry for not too many updates, we are working on another project that is happening soon too)

Regards: Ragdoll Inc

notes.title: Update V0.09
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

We've got a big update for you today. This update was mainly focused on optimization so the game hopefully runs better on all machines. Here's the additons:

- 5 new graphical options in the settings ( Tree distance, grass distance, grass density, render distance and the terrain texture quality distance).

- We have made many optimizations too minimize the impact on your hardware

- Mouse movements are now less delayed

- Minor Bug fixes

It might not seem like much but it really is a big update with all the optimization we have done.

Regards: Ragdoll Inc

notes.title: Update V0.08B
notes.content:
Hello eveyrone, quick little update here to fix a few errors that came up as of the last update. Here are the additons:

- Fixed issue where the player could sprint forever

- Fixed issue where all enemies on Island1 would get stuck between a rock and water.

- Fixed a graphical issue with the "Potato" setting

Regards: Ragdoll Inc

notes.title: Update V0.08
notes.content:
Hello everyone, we have another update for you! This one has many good things in it that I'm sure most people will apperciate. Here are the additons:

- We have done many things to optimise the game more, especially for Mac

- Two brand new lower graphical settings, Very Low and potato. Potato is used for those that are playing on a machine that really can't handle games very well.

- A new Icon on the map (Unlocked when finding location) to help with end game

- A few new large rocks around the map

- New cave like location near base

- We have added in so you cannot walk normal speed or sprint fast while walking backwards

- As the previous may make the game a little harder we have made the enemies slightly slower to compensate

- We have added new tree leaves as the last ones would light up at inappropriate times

- We have made the graphical settings in the main menu now in a drop down menu

We hope you all enjoy the update! 
Regards: Ragdoll Inc

notes.title: Update V0.07
notes.content:
Hello everyone,
This update is small in downalod size but big in fixes and content. Here are the additions:

- A bug where the volume wouldn't change in game has been fixed
- You can now here everything while looking in your map.
- A minor fix where the enemy could get stuck behind a part of water (Island1)
- The fog gate has been fully replaced with wooden planks & a note ( As some people where getting confused as to why they couldn't enter the house)
- Full map UI overhaul, all new icons for the player, clue and skulls
- Stronger intesnity flashlight light
- A new brightness slider for the flashlight ( if you think it is too bright or dark)
- We have change the max intensity that you can change the moonlight
- The main menu and the map are now a bit brighter
- And finally we have tried to fix the enemy circling the player problem.

We hope you all enjoy this new update!
Regards: Ragdoll Inc

notes.title: Update V0.06

notes.content:

Sorry for so many updates today but the last update caused a number of issues to arrise and thus we wanted to update again to fix them as soon as possible.
In this Update:

notes.title: New thread for bugs
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

I have just added a new thread in called "Bugs/Additions" it is so you can post in there about any bugs you encounter or any additions you really think should be apart of the game. I will be reading everysingle post that is posted in that thread. 

Please be respecful of other users in the thread as well. I look forward to hearing what you guys have too say in there as it will help me and the team out too make Escape a better game.

If you do no know how to get to the thread simply click on "Community Hub" then click discussions. You should see the tab for that thread there, you can click "add discussion" too add something you want to say.

Regards: RagdollInc

notes.title: Update V0.05
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

we've got another big update for you all too enjoy. Here are the patch notes:

-New and improved flashlight model

-Large rocks that act as hills added around the map for more realism

-As we added new locations in one of our previous updates we decided to add even more. 10 new locations and things to see have been added around the islands

-Minor Bug fixes

-We have tried to fix the toxic ghost (purple ghost guy) from falling into water by altering some terrain and altering his script. Hopefully he will now be able to get out of water but if no let us know

-Bridge Textures have been updated so they are not stretched anymore

-We have also added in so when a skull is picked up the blip on the map will disappear, so you know you have picked it up.

-And we have added in a new blip on the map to help you with finding out how to get through the fog wall in the main camp. BG

-Also, as some people have been complaining that Escape is too hard we want to give you all a tip. If you are running out of stamina and you have an enemy behind you, try and find the closet rock too jump on. We have made it so once you are on a rock the enemy cannot attack you, so you can safely regain your stamina.
